title: Cardedeu · Nuria's street
description: Cardedeu from OpenStreetMap and a sketch (just geo-build cardedeu), built as a yellow-and-white railway town of the 1900s under the Montseny (docs/places/cardedeu.md): platform 1 and the station's arcaded porch, Nuria's long block with its two hipped roofs and front patios on Carrer de Jacint Verdaguer, the sauló of Plaça de Sant Joan with the town hall's belvedere, the Fleca Vella's real front, Santa Maria's bell tower and the Montseny on the horizon.

steps.caption: Andana 1: the station's porch of round arches, its clock and lanterns, the yellow line and the catenary
Along platform 1 to the west: pavers, lamps, the name board and the fence; the cedars behind
Carrer de Jacint Verdaguer: Nuria at her gate, the front patios, the cars along the east kerb and the walled garden under the cedar
The Doctor Daurella end: the white-roofed corner house in its garden, the zebra, the flats behind
Plaça de Sant Joan: sauló under pollarded plane trees, Torre Lligé's porch, clock and belvedere
Carrer de Teresa Oller: the Fleca Vella's real front, ochre with granite quoins and iron letters
Plaça de l'Església: Santa Maria and its bell tower with Catalan merlons
The north edge: the Montseny's blue ridge over the roofs
From above: hipped clay roofs and terraces, gardens, the railway, and the Montseny behind
